en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The woman widowed from her husband should observe the waiting period when it (news) reaches her because she would want to mourn over him’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A woman whose husband dies must begin counting her waiting period from the day the news reaches her as well as mourning for him.’”
